content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Speakers ## slug: speakers ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End The {{variable.Object_Speaker}}'s page defines any speakers that will be attending your {{variable.Object_Event}}. * You can use the search bar to search for existing {{variable.Object_Contact}}s. The selected {{variable.Object_Contact}} record will populate the {{variable.Object_Speaker}}' record with the {{variable.Object_Contact}} record’s data. The {{variable.Object_Speaker}}' record will include the {{variable.Field_Speaker_ImageURL}} and {{variable.Field_Speaker_AltTextVisualImp}}. * Alternatively, if the {{variable.Object_Speaker}} is not a {{variable.Object_Contact}}, click the {{variable.Button_CreateNew}} button. * Uploading a photo will add the speaker's photo to the {{variable.Object_Speaker}}'s page * Setting the {{variable.Field_Speaker_Status}} field will determine whether your speaker is "Invited," "Confirmed," or "Declined," etc. ![Speakers 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Speakers%201.png){height="" width=""}
